0.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_TALK_ACTOR
0.description: Questions about coverings? By all means, ask away.

4.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDEMENU_A3_000_1
4.description: What are the benefits of covering?

6.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A1_000_01
6.description: Even the best bird has her limits, so what's a trainer to do when <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> chocobo reaches 'em? Arrange a covering, that's what: a union between two retired veterans for the purpose of producing fledglings of a higher pedigree.

7.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A1_000_02
7.description: Strong parents make for strong offspring, after all, an' why let that investment in your veteran go to waste? What's more, the offspring may inherit certain abilities from their parents! Aye, you'd be a fool not to see it done.

8.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A1_000_03
8.description: Once we've finished preparing the newborn fledgling for the races, we'll release him into your care, an' you can start training him in earnest.

9.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A1_000_04
9.description: To arrange a covering, you must be in possession of at least one retired chocobo registration form, which can be obtained by retiring a rank 40 or higher race chocobo.

10.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A1_000_06
10.description: To retire your race chocobo, speak with the race chocobo trainer at the race counter in the Gold Saucer.

11.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A1_000_05
11.description: Please note that this process is not instantaneous, and you will be unable to collect your fledgling prior to the date specified on your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>proof of covering<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

12.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A2_000_01
12.description: Training an' retiring two chocobos to serve as sire an' dam is a rather hefty investment, to say the least. So, in the interests of ensuring a healthy supply of new race chocobos, the Gold Saucer maintains a flock of breeding stock.

13.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A2_000_02
13.description: For a fee, you can rent the services of one of their birds. Unless you're set on doing things the hard way, I'd advise you to consider it.

14.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A2_000_03
14.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Covering permission forms<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> for the use of breeding stock chocobos can be purchased from the tack & feed trader at the race counter in the Gold Saucer. The attributes of these chocobos are randomly determined.

15.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A2_000_04
15.description: Please be advised that two covering permission forms cannot be used to arrange a covering, as both sire and dam cannot be breeding stock.

16.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A2_000_05
16.description: Moreover, please note that covering permission forms are valid for a single use only.

17.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A3_000_01
17.description: It's about probability. The offspring of two fast chocobos is likely to be fast itself, an' so forth.

18.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A3_000_02
18.description: Pair two chocobos of a high pedigree with one another, an' you've a strong chance of getting a fledgling with incredible potential.

19.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A3_000_03
19.description: I say <hex:021A020203>chance<hex:021A020103>, mind you. I've seen run-of-the-mill birds born to champions, an' champions birthed by decidedly average birds.

20.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A3_000_04
20.description: There's no telling exactly how it'll turn out till it does. The Spinner's a fickle mistress, an' all you can do is pray.

21.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A3_000_05
21.description: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pedigree level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> of a chocobo represents its potential as a race chocobo.

22.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACECOUPLINGTALK_00237_GUIDE_A3_000_06
22.description: To view the pedigree of your race chocobo, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Character<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gold Saucer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Next, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Chocobo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from within the interface, then select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Pedigree<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
